summary: Agentic-mesh Web Application – Authentication and Dashboard Functionality
title: Agentic-mesh Web Application – Authentication and Dashboard Functionality
description: The Agentic-mesh application provides a login interface (home.html) for users to authenticate using email and password, a home page (index.html) with navigation to the login page, and a dashboard (dashboard.html) featuring system actions such as logging out, running diagnostics, and downloading access logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user is on the index page, when they click the link labeled "home.html", then the browser navigates to "/home.html" and the login form is displayed

Given the user is on the login page, when they enter a valid email in input#email and a valid password in input#password and click button#submitBtn "Sign In", then the browser redirects to "/dashboard.html"
Given the user is on the login page, when they click button#togglePasswordBtn, then the type attribute of input#password toggles between "password" and "text"
Given the user is on the dashboard page, when they click button#logoutBtn, then the user is logged out and the browser navigates to "/home.html"
Given the user is on the dashboard page, when they click the button labeled "Run System Diagnostics", then a diagnostics modal becomes visible with the text "System Diagnostics Running"
Given the user is on the dashboard page, when they click the button labeled "Download Access Logs", then a file named "access_logs.csv" is downloaded to the user's device
